Technical specifications provide lower-level detail than functional designs and describe all the minutiae to create the application component, e.g.,

  • table names, field names, variable names, formats to use
  • the signature of an interface, including all data types/structures required (input data types, output data types, exceptions)
  • detailed class models including all methods, attributes, dependencies, and associations
  • specific algorithms that a component employs and how it works

Technical specifications will vary according to the type of component or object it relates to, i.e., a technical specification for a workflow will have different content than a technical specification for an interface.
This document provides the detailed information necessary to create a software component or object.
